decisions.reason: This naval vessel lighting line is niche but fits the firm's specialist-lighting capabilities and long qualification cycles make the option worth keeping while demand potential remains uncertain.
The desk lamp extends the ergonomic office offer but is less central to the firm's strategic shift than larger system solutions, so it is kept with a somewhat higher review risk.
A newly arrived general interior luminaire sits close to the core building-lighting business, so with little negative evidence the firm would retain it as a low-cost option.
Because this pendant luminaire is presented as a flagship aligned with the move toward efficient, high-quality application lighting, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it so soon.
The marine HMI searchlight matches the specialist portfolio but its narrower niche and weaker fit with the sustainability and LED direction raise the chance of eventual withdrawal.
A marine searchlight remains consistent with the firm's robust specialist-lighting offer, and absent clear failure signals a German industrial firm would usually keep such a line on the market.
